title: Chicago Jet Ski Rentals at North Ave Beach
includes: Transportation to/from North Avenue Beach (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning Chicago skyline from Lake Michigan with a thrilling jet ski rental at North Ave Beach. Enjoy easy check-in and a designated ride zone for a seamless experience. Perfect for adventure seekers looking to enjoy the open water while soaking in the views.

- 30-minute rentals allow you to ride at your own pace
- Life jackets included, with storage for small gear
- Convenient location at Castaways Beach Club, Chicago
- Book ahead to ensure a spot during peak times
